sources.title: Everything You Need to Know About Meta AI's DINO and SAM
sources.snippet: Meta AI's segment anything model (SAM) specialises in image segmentation. Picture: Meta AI/YouTube Traditionally, computer vision models rely on large datasets of human-labelled images to recognise objects or scenes. DINO discards that constraint by enabling the model to learn directly from the intrinsic structure of images.
